import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
data['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'] + ' ' + data['time'])

# Create a total sales by product and payment method
sales_summary = data.groupby(['product', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a bar plot using seaborn
sns.barplot(data=sales_summary, x='product', y='total', hue='payment_method')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Payment Method', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Payment Method')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
data['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'] + ' ' + data['time'])

# Create a total sales by product and payment method
sales_summary = data.groupby(['product', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a bar plot using seaborn
sns.barplot(data=sales_summary, x='product', y='total', hue='payment_method')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Payment Method', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Payment Method')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
